craft_notes: Sthāyin: śānta as pacification (praśama — the work's seal turned outward); vyabhicāri compassion (karuṇā) for the people's heat. Sanskrit-first: pauṣa/kṛṣṇadaśamī (dark-tenth kept — colophon dates kept honestly, L3-HANDCRAFT rule 5); śamayati (STILLS — same root as śānta: the last verb echoes the rasa); abhinavagupta-signed (signature kept — the hand named). Rows: 12 (śānta-fall for the WHOLE work: desert-heat → stills; the book ends cooling), 10 (Vasura/Pauṣa/dark-tenth left standing — date as image), 1 (‘becoming’ closes — bhava named at the very end: what the hymn pacifies, last). Close: ‘desert-heat of becoming’. Rupture: second dash (signature turns outward — heart to world per C1). Rejected: modernizing the date — killed: colophon honesty; ‘quenches’ — killed: śamayati stills/pacifies (rasa-echo kept); ‘the suffering world’ — killed: jana (people) kept plain. Read aloud: IN the va-SU-ra YEAR, in PAU-ṣa, ON the DARK-tenth — ab-hi-na-va-GUP-ta com-POSED this HYMN — BY-which … IN-a-FLASH STILLS the PEO-ple's DES-ert-HEAT of be-COM-ing.

lines: In the Vasura year, in Pauṣa, on the dark tenth — Abhinavagupta composed this hymn —
by which the pervasive, compassionate Lord in a flash stills the people’s desert-heat of becoming.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vasurasapauṣe kṛṣṇadaśamyām abhinavaguptaḥ stavam imam akarot yena vibhuḥ bhavati janasya arusantāpaṃ śamayati jhaṭiti dayāluḥ
notes: follows bhavamaru (desert-heat of becoming) with L0/NOTE-terms against printed bhavati…arusantāpaṃ; SA untouched pending adjudication
vasurasa kept as year-name (cf. Dyczkowski Vasura-saṃvatsara)

reads_against.argmap: What does the dated, signed hymn accomplish? → Dated and signed: the hymn turns outward, private recognition cools the world.
c1_essence: Dated and signed, it turns outward: the compassionate Lord pacifies the world's heat instantly.
What began in the heart ends in the world: private recognition cools the world.
The colophon dates the composition (Pauṣa, Kṛṣṇa Daśamī) and signs it (Abhinavagupta), then turns to the world.
